channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2024-11182 — MDaemon Email Server
item.description: Threat Signal 57. MDaemon Email Server contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to load arbitrary JavaScript code via an HTML e-mail message.

item.title: CVE-2025-9377 — TP-Link Multiple Routers
item.description: Threat Signal 65. TP-Link Archer C7(EU) and TL-WR841N/ND(MS) contain an OS command injection vulnerability that exists in the Parental Control page. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

item.title: CVE-2026-1603 — Ivanti Endpoint Manager (EPM)
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Ivanti Endpoint Manager (EPM) contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability that could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to leak specific stored credential data.

item.title: CVE-2021-22681 — Rockwell Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Multiple Rockwell products contain an insufficient protected credentials vulnerability. Studio 5000 Logix Designer software may allow a key to be discovered. This key is used to verify Logix controllers are communicating with Rockwell Automation design software. If successfully exploited, this vulnerability could allow an unauthorized application to connect with Logix controllers. To leverage this vulnerability, an unauthorized user would require network access to the controller.

item.title: CVE-2008-0015 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Microsoft Windows Video ActiveX Control contains a remote code execution vulnerability. An attacker could exploit the vulnerability by constructing a specially crafted Web page. When a user views the Web page, the vulnerability could allow remote code execution. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could gain the same user rights as the logged-on user.

item.title: CVE-2025-11371 — Gladinet CentreStack and Triofox
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Gladinet CentreStack and Triofox contains a files or directories accessible to external parties vulnerability that allows unintended disclosure of system files.

item.title: CVE-2025-6205 — Dassault Systèmes DELMIA Apriso
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Dassault Systèmes DELMIA Apriso contains a missing authorization vulnerability that could allow an attacker to gain privileged access to the application.

item.title: CVE-2010-3962 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Microsoft Internet Explorer contains an uninitialized memory corruption vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution. The impacted product could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

item.title: CVE-2020-25078 — D-Link DCS-2530L and DCS-2670L Devices
item.description: Threat Signal 75. D-Link DCS-2530L and DCS-2670L devices contains an unspecified vulnerability that could allow for remote administrator password disclosure. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

item.title: CVE-2019-5418 — Rails Ruby on Rails
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Rails Ruby on Rails contains a path traversal vulnerability in Action View. Specially crafted accept headers in combination with calls to `render file:` can cause arbitrary files on the target server to be rendered, disclosing the file contents.

item.title: CVE-2025-33053 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Microsoft Windows contains an external control of file name or path vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute code from a remote WebDAV location specified by the WorkingDirectory attribute of Internet Shortcut files.

item.title: CVE-2025-4428 — Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM)
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) contains a code injection vulnerability in the API component that allows an authenticated attacker to remotely execute arbitrary code via crafted API requests. This vulnerability results from an insecure implementation of the Hibernate Validator open-source library, as represented by CVE-2025-35036.

item.title: CVE-2025-4427 — Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM)
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the API component that allows an attacker to access protected resources without proper credentials via crafted API requests. This vulnerability results from an insecure implementation of the Spring Framework open-source library.

item.title: CVE-2024-13159 — Ivanti Endpoint Manager (EPM)
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Ivanti Endpoint Manager (EPM) contains an absolute path traversal vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to leak sensitive information.

item.title: CVE-2024-29059 — Microsoft .NET Framework
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Microsoft .NET Framework contains an information disclosure vulnerability that exposes the ObjRef URI to an attacker, ultimately enabling remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2024-45195 — Apache OFBiz
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Apache OFBiz contains a forced browsing vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to obtain unauthorized access.

item.title: CVE-2025-23006 — SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances
item.description: Threat Signal 75. SonicWall SMA1000 Appliance Management Console (AMC) and Central Management Console (CMC) contain a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability, which can enable a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary OS commands.

item.title: CVE-2024-20767 — Adobe ColdFusion
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Adobe ColdFusion contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow an attacker to access or modify restricted files via an internet-exposed admin panel.

item.title: CVE-2024-9680 — Mozilla Firefox
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Mozilla Firefox and Firefox ESR contain a use-after-free vulnerability in Animation timelines that allows for code execution in the content process.

item.title: CVE-2024-28995 — SolarWinds Serv-U
item.description: Threat Signal 75. SolarWinds Serv-U contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an attacker access to read sensitive files on the host machine.

item.title: CVE-2020-17519 — Apache Flink
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Apache Flink contains an improper access control vulnerability that allows an attacker to read any file on the local filesystem of the JobManager through its REST interface.

item.title: CVE-2023-44487 — IETF HTTP/2
item.description: Threat Signal 75. HTTP/2 contains a rapid reset vulnerability that allows for a distributed denial-of-service attack (DDoS).

item.title: CVE-2018-14667 — Red Hat JBoss RichFaces Framework
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Red Hat JBoss RichFaces Framework contains an expression language injection vulnerability via the UserResource resource. A remote, unauthenticated attacker could exploit this vulnerability to execute malicious code using a chain of Java serialized objects via org.ajax4jsf.resource.UserResource$UriData.

item.title: CVE-2017-6884 — Zyxel EMG2926 Routers
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Zyxel EMG2926 routers contain a command injection vulnerability located in the diagnostic tools, specifically the nslookup function. A malicious user may exploit numerous vectors to execute malicious commands on the router, such as the ping_ip parameter to the expert/maintenance/diagnostic/nslookup URI.

item.title: CVE-2023-32315 — Ignite Realtime Openfire
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Ignite Realtime Openfire contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to access restricted pages in the Openfire Admin Console reserved for administrative users.

item.title: CVE-2023-29298 — Adobe ColdFusion
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Adobe ColdFusion contains an improper access control vulnerability that allows for a security feature bypass.

item.title: CVE-2023-38205 — Adobe ColdFusion
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Adobe ColdFusion contains an improper access control vulnerability that allows for a security feature bypass.

item.title: CVE-2019-20500 — D-Link DWL-2600AP Access Point
item.description: Threat Signal 75. D-Link DWL-2600AP access point contains an authenticated command injection vulnerability via the Save Configuration functionality in the Web interface, using shell metacharacters in the admin.cgi?action=config_save configBackup or downloadServerip parameter.

item.title: CVE-2023-21839 — Oracle WebLogic Server
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Oracle WebLogic Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access via T3, IIOP, to compromise Oracle WebLogic Server.

item.title: CVE-2023-24880 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Microsoft Windows SmartScreen contains a security feature bypass vulnerability that could allow an attacker to evade Mark of the Web (MOTW) defenses via a specially crafted malicious file.

item.title: CVE-2021-39226 — Grafana Labs Grafana
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Grafana contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated and unauthenticated users to view and delete all snapshot data, potentially resulting in complete snapshot data loss.

item.title: CVE-2022-26923 — Microsoft Active Directory
item.description: Threat Signal 75. An authenticated user could manipulate attributes on computer accounts they own or manage, and acquire a certificate from Active Directory Certificate Services that would allow for privilege escalation to SYSTEM.

item.title: CVE-2018-17463 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Google Chromium V8 Engine contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute code inside a sandbox via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2012-1889 — Microsoft XML Core Services
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Microsoft XML Core Services contains a memory corruption vulnerability which could allow for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2009-3953 — Adobe Acrobat and Reader
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Adobe Acrobat and Reader contains an array boundary issue in Universal 3D (U3D) support that could lead to remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2024-40711 — Veeam Backup & Replication
item.description: Threat Signal 88. Veeam Backup and Replication contains a deserialization vulnerability allowing an unauthenticated user to perform remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2020-0618 — Microsoft SQL Server
item.description: Threat Signal 88. Microsoft SQL Server Reporting Services contains a deserialization vulnerability when handling page requests incorrectly. An authenticated attacker can exploit this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the Report Server service account.

item.title: CVE-2024-21887 — Ivanti Connect Secure and Policy Secure
item.description: Threat Signal 88. Ivanti Connect Secure (ICS, formerly known as Pulse Connect Secure) and Ivanti Policy Secure contain a command injection vulnerability in the web components of these products, which can allow an authenticated administrator to send crafted requests to execute code on affected appliances. This vulnerability can be leveraged in conjunction with CVE-2023-46805, an authenticated bypass issue.

item.title: CVE-2023-41265 — Qlik Sense
item.description: Threat Signal 88. Qlik Sense contains an HTTP tunneling vulnerability that allows an attacker to escalate privileges and execute HTTP requests on the backend server hosting the software.

item.title: CVE-2021-45046 — Apache Log4j2
item.description: Threat Signal 88. Apache Log4j2 contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability due to the incomplete fix of CVE-2021-44228, where the Thread Context Lookup Pattern is vulnerable to remote code execution in certain non-default configurations.

item.title: CVE-2022-41040 — Microsoft Exchange Server
item.description: Threat Signal 88. Microsoft Exchange Server allows for server-side request forgery. Dubbed "ProxyNotShell," this vulnerability is chainable with CVE-2022-41082 which allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2022-26352 — dotCMS dotCMS
item.description: Threat Signal 88. dotCMS ContentResource API contains an unrestricted upload of file with a dangerous type vulnerability that allows for directory traversal, in which the file is saved outside of the intended storage location. Exploitation allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2022-37042 — Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS)
item.description: Threat Signal 88. Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in MailboxImportServlet. This vulnerability was chained with CVE-2022-27925 which allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2019-7195 — QNAP Photo Station
item.description: Threat Signal 88. QNAP devices running Photo Station contain an external control of file name or path vulnerability allowing remote attackers to access or modify system files.

item.title: CVE-2019-7192 — QNAP Photo Station
item.description: Threat Signal 88. QNAP NAS devices running Photo Station contain an improper access control vulnerability allowing remote attackers to gain unauthorized access to the system.

item.title: CVE-2018-11138 — Quest KACE System Management Appliance
item.description: Threat Signal 88. The '/common/download_agent_installer.php' script in the Quest KACE System Management Appliance is accessible by anonymous users and can be abused to perform remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2017-0144 — Microsoft SMBv1
item.description: Threat Signal 88. The SMBv1 server in multiple Microsoft Windows versions allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted packets.

item.title: CVE-2017-12149 — Red Hat JBoss Application Server
item.description: Threat Signal 88. The JBoss Application Server, shipped with Red Hat Enterprise Application Platform 5.2, allows an attacker to execute arbitrary code via crafted serialized data.

item.title: CVE-2021-40438 — Apache Apache
item.description: Threat Signal 88. A crafted request uri-path can cause mod_proxy to forward the request to an origin server choosen by the remote user. This issue affects Apache HTTP Server 2.4.48 and earlier.

item.title: CVE-2021-34523 — Microsoft Exchange Server
item.description: Threat Signal 88. Microsoft Exchange Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.
